evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: Reporting a ratification enacts authority-ranking — a collective governance act conferring formal approval on a contract; reported=true because the segment reports the act rather than performing it on the audience.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: Framing the contract's value as consequence-for-choice — what you keep or lose depending on client behavior — is proportionality reasoning, the market-pricing relational model.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Describing two equivalent reciprocal paths — poll now or receive piggybacked later — frames an even, one-for-one exchange of information, the equality-matching model.
